## Tables

* english_column_definitions
* french_column_definitions
* abstract: irrelevant
* image_report: image metadata and whatnot
* image_set_report
* location_report: lists all camera locations
* main_report
* megadetector_results
* project_report: irrelevant
* tag_report: animal/tag info inputted by reviewers

location long is not negative when it should be!!

use time and lat long to get weather from external source

```{r}
library(tidyverse)

locations <- read.csv('UWIN_Penn_Vet_Accessing_Nature_May_2025_-_present_2026-10-05_Reports/UWIN_Penn_Vet_UWIN_Penn_Vet_Accessing_Nature_May_2025_-_present_location_report.csv') |>
  mutate(longitude = -abs(longitude)) |>      # location morris_2 /558901/ had a positive lng which was a mistake (presumably)
  mutate(latitude = abs(latitude))            # these standardize the lats and lngs assuming every cam is in the northern & western hemisphere
```

```{r}
library(leaflet)

leaflet(locations) |>
  addTiles() |>
  addMarkers()
```

```{r}
main <- read.csv('UWIN_Penn_Vet_Accessing_Nature_May_2025_-_present_2026-10-05_Reports/UWIN_Penn_Vet_UWIN_Penn_Vet_Accessing_Nature_May_2025_-_present_main_report.csv') |>
  filter(!(species_common_name %in% unhelpful)) |>
  filter(!(species_common_name %in% domestics)) |>
  filter(!(species_scientific_name == '')) |>
  mutate(longitude = -abs(longitude)) |>      # location morris_2 /558901/ had a positive lng which was a mistake (presumably)
  mutate(latitude = abs(latitude)) |>         # these standardize the lats and lngs assuming every cam is in the northern & western hemisphere
  mutate(superlocation = str_extract(location, '[:alpha:]*'))

unique(main$species_common_name)

main |>
  ggplot(aes(x = superlocation)) +
  geom_bar(aes(fill = species_common_name)) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(legend.position = "none") +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 300, vjust = 0.5, hjust = 0))

main |>
  ggplot(aes(x = "", y = species_common_name, fill=species_common_name)) +
  geom_bar(stat="identity", width=1) +
  coord_polar("y", start=0) +
  theme_void() #+
  theme(legend.position = "none")


main |>
  group_by(species_common_name) |>
  summarize(count = n())


unhelpful <- c("STAFF/SETUP", "NONE", "Vehicle", "Unidentified")

domestics <- c("Human", "Domestic Dog", "Domestic Cat (House Cat)")

#unidentified: filter(!(species_scientific_name == ''))
  



  
```
